title: OpenAI pauses training of its ‘most capable models’
slides: OpenAI just paused training its most capable models. Why?
A new safety framework flags risks before training begins.
The pause isn't due to failure—it's a deliberate red-team test.
If you build on OpenAI, your release schedule may shift.
Check if your roadmap depends on unreleased model versions.
thread_text:
1. OpenAI Pauses Its Best Models

Training stopped on the most capable systems before release. Not a failure—a planned safety test.

2. Safety Before Training

A new framework flags risks before a single GPU spins up. Red-teaming now starts at the design stage.

3. The Pause Is the Test

This isn't a breakdown. It's a deliberate stress test to see if safety holds under pressure.

4. Your Release Schedule Shifts

If your product depends on OpenAI's next model, your roadmap may need a backup plan. Start mapping alternatives now.

5. Check Your Roadmap Today

List every feature tied to an unreleased model. If it's more than one, you have a single point of failure.
